description:
* Location: Remote


**About The Job**
 At Alignerr, we partner with the world’s leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting\-edge AI models.
   

  

 You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like machine learning theory, statistical inference, neural network architectures, and data engineering pipelines—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.
   

  

**Organization** 
 : Alignerr
 **Position** 
 : Data Scientist (Masters) \- AI Data Trainer
 **Type** 
 : Hourly Contract
 **Compensation** 
 : $40–$80 /hour
 **Location** 
 : Remote
 **Commitment** 
 : 10–40 hours/week
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Develop Complex Problems: Design advanced data science challenges across domains like hyperparameter optimization, Bayesian inference, cross\-validation strategies, and dimensionality reduction.
* Author Ground\-Truth Solutions: Create rigorous, step\-by\-step technical solutions including Python/R scripts, SQL queries, and mathematical derivations that serve as "golden responses."
* Technical Auditing: Evaluate AI\-generated code (using libraries like Scikit\-Learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow), data visualizations, and statistical summaries for technical accuracy and efficiency.
* Refine Reasoning: Identify logical fallacies in AI reasoning—such as data leakage, overfitting, or improper handling of imbalanced datasets—and provide structured feedback to improve the model's "thinking" process.


**Requirements**
* Advanced Degree: Masters (pursuing or completed) or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a quantitative field with a heavy emphasis on data analysis.
* Domain Expertise: Strong foundational knowledge in core areas such as supervised/unsupervised learning, deep learning, big data technologies (Spark/Hadoop), or NLP.
* Analytical Writing: The ability to communicate highly technical algorithmic concepts and statistical results clearly and concisely in written form.
* Attention to Detail: High level of precision when checking code syntax, mathematical notation, and the validity of statistical conclusions.
* No AI experience required


**Preferred**
* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality, or evaluation systems
* Proficiency in production\-level data science workflows (e.g., MLOps, CI/CD for models).


**Why Join Us**
* Excellent compensation with location\-independent flexibility.
* Direct engagement with industry\-leading LLMs.
* Contractor advantages: high agency, agility, and international reach.
* More opportunities for contracting renewals.


**Application Process (Takes 15\-20 min)**
* Submit your resume
* Complete a short screening
* Project matching and onboarding


*PS: Our team reviews applications daily. Please complete your AI interview and application steps to be considered for this opportunity.*

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Who we are:**
 For over 25 years, Global Relay has set the standard in enterprise information archiving with industry\-leading cloud archiving, surveillance, eDiscovery, and analytics solutions. We securely capture and preserve the communications data of the world’s most highly regulated firms, giving them greater visibility and control over their information and ensuring compliance with stringent regulations.
   

  

 Though we offer competitive compensation and benefits and all the other perks one would expect from an established company, we are not your typical technology company. Global Relay is a career\-building company. A place for big ideas. New challenges. Groundbreaking innovation. It’s a place where you can genuinely make an impact – and be recognized for it.
   

  

 We believe great businesses thrive on diversity, inclusion, and the contributions of all employees. To that end, we recruit candidates from different backgrounds and foster a work environment that encourages employees to collaborate and learn from each other, completely free of barriers.
   

  

**Your role:**
 As a Senior Data Scientist you will be building artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions for Global Relay’s customers. Our solutions are developed by small, focused agile teams of data scientist and developers. You will be applying a wide variety of models to very large electronic communication archives in order to classify and understand communication content. You'll have the opportunity to work in machine translation, transcription, natural language processing, LLMs (large language models), and/or generative AI. You also get to tackle interesting and engaging problems related to scalability and high availability in big data environments.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to work alongside some of the best data scientist in Vancouver and apply your craft in an environment that encourages creative thinking and collaboration.
   

  

**Your job:**
* Work closely with other data scientists and developers in building and deploying various machine learning models
* Execute all steps in the data science process from understanding business requirements to deploying models
* Produce reports detailing model performance
* Take initiative to identify and solve important problems, coordinating with others on cross\-cutting technical issues
* Participate in design review, code review, sprint planning, and other Agile artifacts
* Collaborate with Product Management on user story generation and refinement
* Contribute to knowledge sharing activities with colleagues
* Mentor junior and intermediate data scientist via pairing and reviews
* Instill a spirit of continuous improvement in the team’s code, architecture, and processes


**About you:**
* 5\+ years of experience with solving machine learning problems
* BSc in a STEM or Linguistics subject or equivalent work experience
* Experience working with very large data sets in an enterprise\-wide application environment
* Experience with Python and Bash
* Experience with common machine learning libraries such as: PyTorch, Sklearn, TensorFlow, TensorRT and others
* Experience mentoring junior and intermediate data scientists
* Strong organizational and communication skills


**Nice\-to\-haves:**
* MSc in a STEM or Linguistics subject (considered 1 additional year of experience)
* PhD in a STEM or Linguistics subject (considered 2 additional year of experience)
* Data collection and cleaning experience
* Data engineering skills
* Experience with:
+ Acoustic or language models for speech recognition
+ Natural language processing models
+ Large language models
+ Kubernetes and micro services
+ Working in an agile development environment

title: Senior Data Scientist, Ecommerce
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?
   

  

 At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award\-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.
   

  

 Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
   

  

 ANALYTICS
   

  

**What We Do**
 Our Data \& Analytics teams build powerful stories and visuals that inform the games we make, the technology we develop, and business decisions that drive Epic.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 This position will primarily be responsible for supporting the data requirements of our E\-Commerce and payments functions. The data scientist will work in a cross\-functional team environment under the direction of the Platform Data Science Lead with support and direction from the E\-Commerce Product Director. In addition to other responsibilities, this position will own and optimize processes and programming logic needed to capture data, transform into high usability data models, maintain, and validate the quality of both internally and externally sourced data that is critical in our financial and accounting processes.
   

  

**In this role, you will**
* Work across Accounting, E\-Commerce, Finance, and Analytics teams sharing KPI\-driven reporting and insights
* Partner with ECOM product and programming to design, run, and report experiments to optimize front end and back end payment processing operations
* Develop and maintain standards for dashboards and reporting initiatives. This includes making sure data is visualized appropriately, creating consistent standards, and confirming that all data is accurate
* Partner with stakeholders and programmers to implement best in class data practices
* Provide insights and research into our payment ecosystem from a technical, financial, and user experience perspectiveDocument requirements, develop, and deliver both written reports with analysis and charts on a dashboard

title: Scientifique de données senior/Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Our Mission**


Local Logic is digitizing the built world to make it universally understandable and actionable for consumers, investors, developers, and governments with the ambition of helping build cities that are more sustainable and equitable for the people who live in them.


To achieve that dream, we’ve built a digital twin of cities, quantifying the built world using data and AI to interpret the $217T real estate market throughout the US and Canada.


We started our journey at McGill University’s urban planning department, where we came to see that cities were being developed in all kinds of unsustainable ways. Why were sprawling suburbs still being built, when doing so would increase pollution and inequality? Why were new business parks being built far from mass transit, when doing so would make traffic congestion skyrocket? Why was social housing being built in places that would exacerbate social problems rather than improve them?


It became clear to us why: cities are incredibly difficult to understand. However, we realized that with recent advances in data science, all the complexity of cities could be made simple enough for anyone to understand. And that understanding would be essential to making the sustainable, equitable, and prosperous cities that we so desperately need.


Today, Local Logic delivers sophisticated location insights through webtools, APIs, one\-click reports and a data analytics platform. Our insights are powered by billions of data points we’ve generated that describe all aspects of cities \- from the distance to the nearest bus stop, the quietness on the street, to the most recent trends in the housing market and more.

**Your Mission**


As a **Senior Data Scientist at Local Logic**, you will play a key role in shaping how cities and real estate are understood, evaluated, and acted upon. You’ll work at the intersection of **urban data, real estate analytics, and product decision\-making**, helping uncover insights that influence both our product strategy and the data products we bring to market.


You will own complex, ambiguous problems end\-to\-end: from framing the right questions, to designing robust analytical or modeling approaches, to translating results into concrete decisions and products. You’ll work across **continental\-scale geospatial and behavioral datasets**, combining quantitative rigor with strong product intuition.


This role is ideal for a senior data scientist who enjoys operating in a fast\-moving environment, values intellectual autonomy, and wants their work to have visible, real\-world impact on how people understand places and make real estate decisions.


You believe in our mission and want to help us achieve it. You bring your own unique perspective to the team, so you can challenge the way we do things for the better. You’re able to speak up when you disagree, ask questions when you don’t understand, and take ownership of your work.

**As Our Senior Data Scientist, Your Responsibilities Will Include:**

* **Own high\-impact analytical and modeling problems** related to cities, real estate, and product usage, from discovery to delivery
* Conduct quantitative research to assess the value of our city and real estate data for key users, including home seekers, cities, real estate platforms, and investors
* Design, build, and evaluate **machine learning and statistical models**, with a focus on real\-world constraints, data quality, and interpretability
* Develop **proofs of concept for new data products** and collaborate closely with data engineers to productionize them
* Define and maintain **product analytics pipelines, metrics, and reporting** for internal teams and external partners
* Influence **product strategy and roadmap decisions** through proactive insights and data\-informed recommendations
* Act as a **methodological reference** within the data team, helping set best practices around analysis, modeling, and validation
* Be a steward of **data quality and reliability**, identifying risks and trade\-offs in data and methods
* Communicate clearly and convincingly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders about findings, assumptions, and limitations
* Write analytical reports for clients and partners in **both French and English**

 **Key Requirements:**

* **5\+ years of experience** in quantitative research and data science roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex problems
* Strong experience working with **large, messy, real\-world datasets**
* Proven experience with **machine learning and/or advanced modeling techniques**, from problem framing to evaluation
* Solid experience with **product analytics**, metrics definition, and decision support
* Strong programming skills in **Python and SQL** for analysis and modeling.
* Comfortable operating in **ambiguous, fast\-changing environments**, where defining the problem is part of the job
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analyses to diverse audiences
* **Fluent in French and English** (written and spoken)
* This is a hybrid position and it is expected that you will work from the Montreal office Tuesdays and Thursdays

 **Nice to Have:**

* Experience in **real estate, urban analytics, econometrics or related domains** (e.g., investment analysis, city planning)
* Hands\-on experience with **geospatial and spatio\-temporal data** (GIS, spatial modeling, urban indicators, mobility, accessibility, etc.)
* Exposure to **risk modeling** or decision\-making under uncertainty

 **Why should you work here**


At Local Logic, you have an amazing opportunity to be an early team member of a Series B backed startup. We are focused on understanding the world and its cities to predict the future and make the real estate market more transparent.


We are a people\-first company that strives to create the best experience for our employees by creating an inclusive, collaborative, challenging environment to learn and problem\-solve on a daily basis.


You will have access to benefits such as:

* Comprehensive health insurance on us
* A health platform (telemedicine, Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP), mental health and stress management assistance) (\*for Canadians only)
* Stock options
* Unlimited vacation
* Intentional Fridays
* Health and benefit allowance per year
* Initial WFH allowance
* Bike sharing membership on us
* A cool office in the heart of Montreal


Your professional development is our priority. With a 1500 CAD annual professional development credit you’re encouraged to keep learning, explore new skills, and advance in your career. We want you to thrive, grow, and feel fulfilled while working on work that matters. Join us, and help us build a brighter future for cities around the world.

**Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion**


We’re aiming to build a diverse team and inclusive company culture. We are an equal opportunity employer (EOE) and do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

  

\~\~

**Notre Mission**


Chez Local Logic, notre mission est d'améliorer toutes les décisions immobilières, qu'il s'agisse des consommateurs à la recherche d'un quartier qui correspond à leur style de vie, des investisseurs qui cherchent à repérer les meilleurs emplacements à développer, ou des gouvernements locaux qui s'efforcent de construire des villes plus durables grâce à une meilleure planification urbaine.


Nous avons commencé notre parcours au département d'urbanisme de l'université McGill, où nous avons constaté que les villes se développaient de toutes sortes de manières non durables. Pourquoi continuer à construire des banlieues tentaculaires, alors que cela a pour effet d'accroître la pollution et les inégalités ? Pourquoi de nouvelles zones d'activités sont\-elles construites loin des transports en commun, alors que cela fait exploser les embouteillages ? Pourquoi les logements sociaux sont\-ils construits dans des endroits qui exacerbent les problèmes sociaux au lieu de les améliorer ?


Nous avons compris pourquoi : Les villes sont incroyablement difficiles à comprendre. Mais, nous avons réalisé qu'avec les progrès récents de la science des données, toute la complexité des villes peut être simplifiée pour que n'importe qui puisse la comprendre. Cette compréhension est essentielle pour créer des villes durables, équitables et prospères dont nous avons désespérément besoin.


Aujourd'hui, notre vaste ensemble de plus de 100 milliards de points de données fournit des informations et des analyses inégalées qui ont influencé des transactions immobilières d'une valeur de plusieurs milliards de dollars et qui aident en permanence plus de 15 millions d'utilisateurs mensuels, sur 8 000 sites web aux États\-Unis et au Canada, à prendre des décisions plus éclairées.


Au cours de l'été 2023, nous avons obtenu un financement de série B afin d'agrandir notre équipe, d'améliorer nos produits et, en fin de compte, d'aider à construire les villes de demain.

**Votre mission**


En tant que **Scientifique de données senior chez Local Logic**, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la façon dont les villes et l’immobilier sont compris, analysés et utilisés pour la prise de décision. Vous travaillerez sur des jeux de données géospatiales et comportementales à grande échelle (continentale), en combinant **rigueur quantitative** et **forte intuition produit**.


Ce rôle s’adresse à une ou un scientifique de données senior qui aime évoluer dans un environnement en constante évolution, qui valorise l’autonomie intellectuelle et qui souhaite que son travail ait un impact concret et visible sur la manière dont les gens comprennent les lieux et prennent des décisions immobilières.

Vous apportez votre point de vue unique à l’équipe et êtes à l’aise de remettre en question nos façons de faire afin de les améliorer. * Prendre en charge des problématiques analytiques et de modélisation à fort impact liées aux villes, à l’immobilier et à l’utilisation des produits, de l’exploration initiale jusqu’à la mise en production
* Mener des recherches quantitatives afin d’évaluer la valeur de nos données urbaines et immobilières pour nos principaux utilisateurs, notamment les acheteurs de propriétés, les villes, les plateformes immobilières et les investisseurs
* Concevoir, développer et évaluer des modèles statistiques et d’apprentissage automatique, en tenant compte des contraintes du monde réel, de la qualité des données et de l’interprétabilité

* Être un·e gardien·ne de la qualité et de la fiabilité des données, en identifiant les risques et les compromis liés aux données et aux méthodes utilisées

* Rédiger des rapports analytiques pour les clients et partenaires, en français et en anglais

 Power Factors' Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market participation. The company's suite of open, data\-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end\-to\-end support, including solutions for SCADA \& PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

* Outside China and India

**About The Role**
 As Principal Data Scientist on our Innovation team, you'll identify and prototype breakthrough solutions using Power Factors' extensive operational database of 200\+ GW renewable assets. You'll drive new product development from concept to reality, working hands\-on with Python and AI while collaborating closely with software developers, product managers, and customers. Your innovations will directly create new revenue streams. This role offers a rare opportunity to combine deep technical work with entrepreneurial impact—helping renewable energy become the world's leading power source.
   

  

**About You**
 You're a seasoned data scientist with 12\+ years in renewable energy, deeply familiar with wind, solar, and battery storage operations. You're fluent in Python, machine learning, and AI, but more importantly, you know how to translate technical capabilities into business value. You thrive collaborating with software developers and can move seamlessly between writing production code and presenting insights to customers.
   

  

 What drives you is innovation—spotting opportunities in data, building prototypes, and creating new revenue streams from scratch. You're self\-motivated, entrepreneurial, and energized by ambiguity. The chance to leverage Power Factors' 200\+ GW operational database to accelerate the green energy transition isn't just appealing—it's exactly why you do this work. You're ready to make renewable energy win.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Experience \& Domain Expertise
   

  

* 12\+ years of experience in the renewable energy industry, with a proven track record at established consultants, energy asset owners, or asset operators
* Deep understanding of solar, wind, and battery storage asset operations, performance characteristics, and development / operational challenges
* Demonstrated experience working with large\-scale operational datasets from renewable energy assets
* Demonstrated experience building prototypes and products used by energy asset owners, developers and operators to impact business decisions


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Advanced proficiency in Python and modern data science libraries (pandas, scikit\-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch, etc.)
* Strong command of statistical analysis, machine learning, and AI techniques with practical application experience
* Hands\-on experience with data engineering concepts and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Proven ability to take concepts from ideation through prototype to production\-ready solutions
* Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative software development practices


 Collaboration \& Communication
   

  

* Ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Experience collaborating closely with software engineering teams and speaking their language (APIs, microservices, deployment pipelines, etc.)
* Track record of translating customer needs and business opportunities into technical solutions


 Mindset \& Approach
   

  

* Self\-motivated with demonstrated ability to identify opportunities and drive initiatives independently
* Entrepreneurial mindset with experience in innovation or new product development
* Comfort with ambiguity and ability to navigate unstructured problem spaces


**Beneficial Qualifications**
* PhD or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, Engineering, or related quantitative field
* Experience with time\-series forecasting, anomaly detection, or predictive maintenance in industrial settings
* Prior experience in a consultancy environment interfacing directly with clients
* Familiarity with SCADA systems, asset performance monitoring platforms, or energy trading/markets
* Background in developing commercial products or revenue\-generating data solutions
* Experience with real\-time data processing and streaming analytics
* Knowledge of energy market structures, power purchase agreements (PPAs), or grid operations
* Published research or patents in renewable energy, machine learning, or related fields
* Experience with MLOps practices and deploying models at scale
* Contributions to open\-source projects or active participation in the data science community


**Responsibilities**
 Innovation \& Product Development
   

  

* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize innovative opportunities to create new revenue streams for Power Factors
* Lead the development of novel data science solutions from concept through prototype, leveraging Power Factors' extensive operational database of 200\+ GW of renewable assets

 By joining the Power Factors team, you'll be part of a dynamic group of innovative and driven individuals dedicated to making a positive impact. Every day, your work will directly contribute to advancing clean energy solutions and supporting global sustainability initiatives. With many opportunities for professional growth, Power Factors is here to support your development as we lead the charge in transforming the energy industry.

title: Scientifique de données senior/Senior Data Scientist
description:
Our Mission
   

  

 Local Logic is digitizing the built world to make it universally understandable and actionable for consumers, investors, developers, and governments with the ambition of helping build cities that are more sustainable and equitable for the people who live in them.
   

  

 To achieve that dream, we’ve built a digital twin of cities, quantifying the built world using data and AI to interpret the $217T real estate market throughout the US and Canada.
   

  

 We started our journey at McGill University’s urban planning department, where we came to see that cities were being developed in all kinds of unsustainable ways. Why were sprawling suburbs still being built, when doing so would increase pollution and inequality? Why were new business parks being built far from mass transit, when doing so would make traffic congestion skyrocket? Why was social housing being built in places that would exacerbate social problems rather than improve them?
   

  

 It became clear to us why: cities are incredibly difficult to understand. However, we realized that with recent advances in data science, all the complexity of cities could be made simple enough for anyone to understand. And that understanding would be essential to making the sustainable, equitable, and prosperous cities that we so desperately need.
   

  

 Today, Local Logic delivers sophisticated location insights through webtools, APIs, one\-click reports and a data analytics platform. Our insights are powered by billions of data points we’ve generated that describe all aspects of cities \-\- from the distance to the nearest bus stop, the quietness on the street, to the most recent trends in the housing market and more.
   

  

 Your Mission
   

  

 As a Senior Data Scientist at Local Logic, you will play a key role in shaping how cities and real estate are understood, evaluated, and acted upon. You’ll work at the intersection of urban data, real estate analytics, and product decision\-making, helping uncover insights that influence both our product strategy and the data products we bring to market.
   

  

 You will own complex, ambiguous problems end\-to\-end: from framing the right questions, to designing robust analytical or modeling approaches, to translating results into concrete decisions and products. You’ll work across continental\-scale geospatial and behavioral datasets, combining quantitative rigor with strong product intuition.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a senior data scientist who enjoys operating in a fast\-moving environment, values intellectual autonomy, and wants their work to have visible, real\-world impact on how people understand places and make real estate decisions.
   

  

 You believe in our mission and want to help us achieve it. You bring your own unique perspective to the team, so you can challenge the way we do things for the better. You’re able to speak up when you disagree, ask questions when you don’t understand, and take ownership of your work.
   

  

 As Our Senior Data Scientist, Your Responsibilities Will Include:
   

  

* Own high\-impact analytical and modeling problems related to cities, real estate, and product usage, from discovery to delivery
* Conduct quantitative research to assess the value of our city and real estate data for key users, including home seekers, cities, real estate platforms, and investors
* Design, build, and evaluate machine learning and statistical models, with a focus on real\-world constraints, data quality, and interpretability
* Develop proofs of concept for new data products and collaborate closely with data engineers to productionize them
* Define and maintain product analytics pipelines, metrics, and reporting for internal teams and external partners
* Influence product strategy and roadmap decisions through proactive insights and data\-informed recommendations
* Act as a methodological reference within the data team, helping set best practices around analysis, modeling, and validation
* Be a steward of data quality and reliability, identifying risks and trade\-offs in data and methods
* Communicate clearly and convincingly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders about findings, assumptions, and limitations
* Write analytical reports for clients and partners in both French and English


 Key Requirements:
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in quantitative research and data science roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex problems
* Strong experience working with large, messy, real\-world datasets
* Proven experience with machine learning and/or advanced modeling techniques, from problem framing to evaluation
* Solid experience with product analytics, metrics definition, and decision support
* Strong programming skills in Python and SQL for analysis and modeling.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments, where defining the problem is part of the job
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analyses to diverse audiences
* Fluent in French and English (written and spoken)
* This is a hybrid position and it is expected that you will work from the Montreal office Tuesdays and Thursdays


 Nice to Have:
   

  

* Experience in real estate, urban analytics, econometrics or related domains (e.g., investment analysis, city planning)
* Hands\-on experience with geospatial and spatio\-temporal data (GIS, spatial modeling, urban indicators, mobility, accessibility, etc.)
* Exposure to risk modeling or decision\-making under uncertainty


 Why should you work here
   

  

 At Local Logic, you have an amazing opportunity to be an early team member of a Series B backed startup. We are focused on understanding the world and its cities to predict the future and make the real estate market more transparent.
   

  

 We are a people\-first company that strives to create the best experience for our employees by creating an inclusive, collaborative, challenging environment to learn and problem\-solve on a daily basis.
   

  

 You will have access to benefits such as:
   

  

* Comprehensive health insurance on us
* A health platform (telemedicine, Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP), mental health and stress management assistance) (\*for Canadians only)
* Stock options
* Unlimited vacation
* Intentional Fridays
* Health and benefit allowance per year
* Initial WFH allowance
* Bike sharing membership on us
* A cool office in the heart of Montreal


 Your professional development is our priority. With a 1500 CAD annual professional development credit you’re encouraged to keep learning, explore new skills, and advance in your career. We want you to thrive, grow, and feel fulfilled while working on work that matters. Join us, and help us build a brighter future for cities around the world.
   

  

 Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion
   

  

 We’re aiming to build a diverse team and inclusive company culture. We are an equal opportunity employer (EOE) and do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.
   

  

 \~\~
   

  

 Notre Mission
   

  

 Chez Local Logic, notre mission est d'améliorer toutes les décisions immobilières, qu'il s'agisse des consommateurs à la recherche d'un quartier qui correspond à leur style de vie, des investisseurs qui cherchent à repérer les meilleurs emplacements à développer, ou des gouvernements locaux qui s'efforcent de construire des villes plus durables grâce à une meilleure planification urbaine.
   

  

 Nous avons commencé notre parcours au département d'urbanisme de l'université McGill, où nous avons constaté que les villes se développaient de toutes sortes de manières non durables. Pourquoi continuer à construire des banlieues tentaculaires, alors que cela a pour effet d'accroître la pollution et les inégalités ? Pourquoi de nouvelles zones d'activités sont\-elles construites loin des transports en commun, alors que cela fait exploser les embouteillages ? Pourquoi les logements sociaux sont\-ils construits dans des endroits qui exacerbent les problèmes sociaux au lieu de les améliorer ?
   

  

 Nous avons compris pourquoi : Les villes sont incroyablement difficiles à comprendre. Mais, nous avons réalisé qu'avec les progrès récents de la science des données, toute la complexité des villes peut être simplifiée pour que n'importe qui puisse la comprendre. Cette compréhension est essentielle pour créer des villes durables, équitables et prospères dont nous avons désespérément besoin.
   

  

 Aujourd'hui, notre vaste ensemble de plus de 100 milliards de points de données fournit des informations et des analyses inégalées qui ont influencé des transactions immobilières d'une valeur de plusieurs milliards de dollars et qui aident en permanence plus de 15 millions d'utilisateurs mensuels, sur 8 000 sites web aux États\-Unis et au Canada, à prendre des décisions plus éclairées.
   

  

 Au cours de l'été 2023, nous avons obtenu un financement de série B afin d'agrandir notre équipe, d'améliorer nos produits et, en fin de compte, d'aider à construire les villes de demain.
   

  

 Votre mission
   

  

 En tant que Scientifique de données senior chez Local Logic, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la façon dont les villes et l’immobilier sont compris, analysés et utilisés pour la prise de décision. Vous travaillerez à l’intersection des données urbaines, de l’analytique immobilière et des décisions produit, afin de faire émerger des insights qui influencent à la fois notre stratégie produit et les produits de données que nous mettons sur le marché.
   

  

 Vous prendrez en charge des problématiques complexes et ambiguës de bout en bout : de la formulation des bonnes questions, à la conception d’approches analytiques ou de modélisation robustes, jusqu’à la traduction des résultats en décisions concrètes et en produits. Vous travaillerez sur des jeux de données géospatiales et comportementales à grande échelle (continentale), en combinant rigueur quantitative et forte intuition produit.
   

  

 Ce rôle s’adresse à une ou un scientifique de données senior qui aime évoluer dans un environnement en constante évolution, qui valorise l’autonomie intellectuelle et qui souhaite que son travail ait un impact concret et visible sur la manière dont les gens comprennent les lieux et prennent des décisions immobilières.
   

  

 Vous croyez en notre mission et souhaitez contribuer activement à sa réalisation. Vous apportez votre point de vue unique à l’équipe et êtes à l’aise de remettre en question nos façons de faire afin de les améliorer. Vous savez vous exprimer lorsque vous êtes en désaccord, poser des questions lorsque quelque chose n’est pas clair et prendre pleinement la responsabilité de votre travail.
   

  

 Vos responsabilités incluront :
   

  

* Prendre en charge des problématiques analytiques et de modélisation à fort impact liées aux villes, à l’immobilier et à l’utilisation des produits, de l’exploration initiale jusqu’à la mise en production
* Mener des recherches quantitatives afin d’évaluer la valeur de nos données urbaines et immobilières pour nos principaux utilisateurs, notamment les acheteurs de propriétés, les villes, les plateformes immobilières et les investisseurs
* Concevoir, développer et évaluer des modèles statistiques et d’apprentissage automatique, en tenant compte des contraintes du monde réel, de la qualité des données et de l’interprétabilité
* Développer des preuves de concept pour de nouveaux produits de données et collaborer étroitement avec les ingénieur·e·s de données pour les mettre en production
* Définir et maintenir des pipelines d’analytique produit, des indicateurs clés et des rapports destinés aux équipes internes et aux partenaires externes
* Influencer la stratégie produit et la feuille de route grâce à des insights proactifs et à des recommandations fondées sur les données
* Agir comme référence méthodologique au sein de l’équipe de données, en contribuant à l’établissement de bonnes pratiques en matière d’analyse, de modélisation et de validation
* Être un·e gardien·ne de la qualité et de la fiabilité des données, en identifiant les risques et les compromis liés aux données et aux méthodes utilisées
* Communiquer de manière claire et convaincante, tant auprès de publics techniques que non techniques, au sujet des résultats, des hypothèses et des limites des analyses
* Rédiger des rapports analytiques pour les clients et partenaires, en français et en anglais


 Exigences clés
   

  

* 5 ans ou plus d’expérience en recherche quantitative et en science des données, avec une prise en charge démontrée de problématiques complexes
* Solide expérience de travail avec des données volumineuses, imparfaites et issues du monde réel
* Expérience avérée en apprentissage automatique et/ou en techniques avancées de modélisation, de la définition du problème à l’évaluation des résultats
* Bonne expérience en analytique produit, incluant la définition de métriques et le soutien à la prise de décision
* Excellentes compétences en programmation en Python et SQL pour l’analyse et la modélisation
* À l’aise dans des environnements ambigus et en évolution rapide, où la définition du problème fait partie intégrante du travail
* Excellentes aptitudes en communication, avec la capacité d’expliquer des analyses complexes à des auditoires variés
* Bilingue français et anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit
* Poste hybride, avec une présence attendue au bureau de Montréal les mardis et jeudis


 Atouts supplémentaires
   

  

* Expérience dans les domaines de l’immobilier, de l’analytique urbaine, de l’économétrie ou dans des domaines connexes (p. ex. analyse d’investissement, planification urbaine)
* Expérience pratique avec des données géospatiales et spatio\-temporelles (SIG, modélisation spatiale, indicateurs urbains, mobilité, accessibilité, etc.)

 Pourquoi travailler ici
   

  

 Chez Local Logic, vous avez l'opportunité de faire partie de l'équipe d'une jeune pousse, soutenue par sa série B. Nous nous concentrons sur la compréhension du monde et de ses villes pour prédire l'avenir et rendre le marché immobilier plus transparent.

Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,500 companies create a better world of work. Work with cutting edge AI technology, making the world a safer and more secure place. DroneShield (ASX:DRO) offers an opportunity to solve some of world’s most challenging technical problems in the rapidly growing counter\-drone sector.


Our customers operate in some of the most challenging and high\-stakes environments in the world, including military organisations, government agencies, airports, critical infrastructure operators, and law enforcement. Protecting airspace in these settings requires technology that performs under pressure and teams that understand what’s at stake. At DroneShield, employees work at the leading edge of counter\-drone innovation, helping to address real\-world security challenges as drone threats continue to evolve globally.


With one of the largest listed defence company market capitalisations in Australia, now part of the ASX200 index, DroneShield is experiencing a period of hypergrowth. The company has grown from 11 employees in 2017 to over 450 staff globally today, and is on track to reach around 550 by the end of 2026\. This expansion includes investment of over A$50 million annually in R\&D, a global pipeline exceeding A$2\.5 billion, and continuous scaling of production capacity to meet accelerating demand.


The role is based at DroneShield’s central Sydney headquarters. Overseas on\-the\-ground presence includes Virginia (USA), Netherlands, Denmark, Mexico and Dubai, as well as distributors in over 70 countries worldwide.

 **About the role**


DroneShield is seeking a hands\-on QA Software Engineer with experience in software system validation and exposure to AI/ML\-driven and sensor\-integrated platforms. You will contribute to test execution, automation, and quality practices across Linux\-based systems that integrate software services, firmware components, intelligent models, and sensors.


In this role, you will work closely with engineers across software, data, and DevOps teams to support end\-to\-end QA activities, including functional, integration, and regression testing.


The ideal candidate is a motivated team player who can plan and execute testing tasks independently, contribute to automation efforts, and continuously improve product quality within a collaborative, fast\-paced environment.

**Responsibilities, Duties and Expectations**

* Design, execute, and maintain manual and automated tests across software components and integrated systems.
* Contribute to test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines under guidance from senior engineers.
* Plan and execute test cycles for software features, APIs, and integrated solutions.
* Perform hands\-on testing, including functional, regression, and integration testing.
* Support field testing activities for embedded or integrated products when required.
* Collaborate with software engineers, data scientists, and DevOps teams to improve test coverage and product quality.
* Create and maintain test cases, test data, and test documentation in test management tools.
* Identify, log, and track defects, and assist in root\-cause analysis.
* Actively participate in improving QA processes, standards, and test practices.

**Qualifications, Experience and Skills**

* 3–6 years of experience as a QA or Software Test Engineer.
* Solid understanding of software testing fundamentals across web, API, and backend systems.
* Working knowledge of Linux and test automation tools such as Selenium, Pytest, Playwright, or K6\.
* Programming or scripting experience in Python, JavaScript, or Go.
* Hands\-on experience with test management tools such as Xray, Zephyr, or QMetry.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and basic containerisation concepts (e.g. Docker).
* Ability to plan and execute testing tasks independently with guidance when needed.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and communication skills.

**Desirable**

* Exposure to embedded systems, IoT, or hardware\-integrated software testing.
* Experience with non\-functional testing, including performance or reliability testing.
* Familiarity with testing AI/ML\-driven or data\-intensive systems.
* Awareness of sensor\-based systems or edge\-device testing concepts.

description:
The Centre for Population Genomics (CPG) is a joint national initiative of the Garvan Institute of Medical Research and the Murdoch Children’s Research Institute (MCRI). The Institutes are national leaders in genomic research, with complementary strengths spanning large\-scale genomics, data science, population health, and clinical impact.  

The Centre for Population Genomics is a young not\-for\-profit research initiative working to build a more equitable future for genomic medicine. We are a remote\-first, geographically distributed hub for innovation in genomics, data science, and clinical translation, with over 40 team members located across Australia and New Zealand.  

THE OPPORTUNITY  

The Operational Support Officer plays an important role in the flawless execution and delivery of the CPG’s operational strategy. A key member of the Operations team, this individual ensures the efficient management of CPG’s logistics, including onboarding, offboarding, policy and procedure development, event planning, scheduling and ad hoc administrative duties.  

You will be instrumental in providing support across the CPG facilitating problem solving and developing solutions with the Leadership Team and team members. Furthermore, you will act as the face of CPG at both Garvan and MCRI, working closely with key stakeholders in both institutes to ensure the operational needs of CPG are met in a timely and efficient manner.  

To excel in this role, you will be an adaptable, organised and detail\-oriented individual capable of managing multiple tasks simultaneously whilst maintaining a high standard of operation excellence. In addition to being a natural team player, you are comfortable with operating independently and autonomously.  

You are passionate about CPG’s impact mission and are genuinely committed and engaged by
operational support and organisational facilitation in this context. Working with team members across the organisation and positively impacting their experience at work will give you a great sense of pride and you have a great sense of care and dedication to getting the job done.  

This position presents a unique opportunity to leverage your operations expertise to support an environment that empowers our research teams and professional staff. Your contributions will enable us to develop nationally significant resources, offer new diagnoses to numerous children affected by rare genetic diseases, and ultimately create systems that deliver improved health information and innovative therapies to thousands of Australians.  

The individual will ideally be physically based either at the Garvan Institute in Sydney or the MCRI in Melbourne.  

CPG operates in a remote\-first/hybrid working environment, but the individual will be required to regularly attend the office as well as quarterly in\-person team events. The ideal candidate will thrive in a virtual work environment and display agility by integrating a combination of working from home and the office.  

Salary: Up to $80,000 \+ 12% super \+ salary packaging (depending on experience)
Employment Type: 1\-year fixed\-term contract, full\-time  

SNAPSHOT OF BENEFITS* Generous salary packaging to save you income tax on your wages thereby boosting your monthly take home pay (max. $15,900 general expenses \+ $2,650 meals/accom)
* Ample opportunities for on\-going training and development
* Stimulating, diverse and highly international research environment
* Flexible work arrangements e.g. start / finish times
* 18 weeks paid parental leave for both parents including paid superannuation
* A range of additional leave types to meet your personal needs including cultural leave, conference leave, community service and study leave
* Discounted Health Insurance
* Lifestyle discounts with our community partners
  

WHAT YOU WILL DO  

The key responsibilities include:* Working closely with the Operations Lead, you will be required to coordinate and deliver on all aspects of Operations at CPG.
* Working with the Operations team to assist with the end\-to\-end people operations, including employee onboarding and offboarding, ensuring a consistent, compliant, and positive experience across the employee lifecycle.
* Assist with developing, implementing, and maintaining CPG organisational policies and procedures, ensuring they are current, clearly documented, and aligned with business, legal, and cultural requirements.
* Working with key stakeholders, plan and coordinate CPG events, including logistics, scheduling, and liaising with vendors, to ensure successful event execution that aligns with the Centre’s objectives.
* Act as a primary liaison between CPG and key stakeholders at Garvan and MCRI ensuring the operational needs of CPG are effectively communicated and met.
* Facilitate problem\-solving and develop solutions in collaboration with both leadership and staff to address operational challenges and improve efficiency.
* Provide support to other Operations staff, and staff across the CPG teams
* Actively invest in building and maintaining a positive, supportive and high\-performing culture within the Operations Team, and CPG more broadly.
* Other duties as assigned.
* All staff are required to comply with Garvan’s workplace policies (as amended from time to time) and especially Garvan’s Work Health \& Safety (WHS) Policy, including working in accordance with the WHS management system at all times, as safety is Garvan’s number one priority.
  

ABOUT YOU  

The key skills and experience include:* At least 3 years of experience in operations roles, including experience overseeing policy development and management, administrative tasks, and team support
* Outstanding people skills, proactive in communication, and capable of fostering relationships across teams and institutes
* A genuine passion and enthusiasm for CPG’s mission
* Demonstrate a proactive approach to operations support, with a keen ability to pinpoint and resolve bottlenecks effectively
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated experience successfully working in a remote\-first environment
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage a complex and dynamic workload
* Ability to thrive in an interdisciplinary team setting including biologists, data scientists, software engineers, community engagement specialists, and project management staff
* Familiarity with Slack, GSuite, and Atlassian products would be beneficial but not required

Garvan Institute of Medical Research is an independent Medical Research Institute (MRI) in Sydney, delivering scientific and clinical impact on a global basis and in partnership with organisations that share our vision. We are proud to be one of Australia’s largest and most highly regarded MRI’s.  

Our vision is global leadership in discoveries to impact and our enduring purpose is to impact human health, by harnessing information encoded in our genome.  

We seek to see our world\-class discovery research achieve life\-changing impacts, not only for individual patients with rare diseases, but for the many thousands affected by complex, common disease. *Garvan promotes a diverse workplace and is committed to the principles of equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging. We are always looking for culture ‘add**’,**not culture ‘fit’ and are building diverse teams with great sets of complementary styles and skills to help deliver our important work effectively.*

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**About Kasada**
 Join us in stopping bad bots, for good! Kasada protects millions of online users everyday. Founded to stop automated bot attacks, we believe the internet should be a safe place for everyone. Bad bots are highly destructive. They take over accounts, steal content, overload systems and infrastructure and cause billions of dollars in damages every year. Seeking to restore trust in the internet, Kasada stops bots at the very first request including those that have never been seen before.
   

  

 We’ve grown from a few friends working out of a shipping container under the Sydney Harbour Bridge to now operating globally, we’re spread across the world protecting some of the most well\-known brands on the face of the earth.
   

  

 We’re an innately curious team that’s not afraid to bring bold ideas to create better ways of solving problems. We’re looking for people who are passionate about solving some of the most difficult and pressing cybersecurity issues, while having fun doing it!
   

  

 You will be the founding member of the Data Science team that we’re bootstrapping. You will work closely with one of our Product Managers who has a background in cybersecurity and a PhD in adversarial ML. You get to learn the domain from our many experienced security analysts, researchers and engineers working on both the detection and data systems side. This is a startup environment, so having high agency and a bias towards an iterative approach will help you thrive. This is not another GenAI thing!
   

  

 In terms of existing tech stack: it is all AWS. Our data environment is Kafka, Fink, S3, Athena, Clickhouse. Most production applications, including detection systems are written in NodeJS. Notebooks are written in Jupyter with SageMaker tooling. We’re flexible on evolving our current tooling to suit future data science needs \- which is a great opportunity for you to shape our direction.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Develop, train, and deploy ML models to detect automation and fraud across large\-scale, high\-velocity traffic
* Explore massive datasets to identify anomalies, uncover new adversarial behaviours, and anticipate attack vectors
* Build and maintain scalable pipelines and frameworks that can handle real\-time detection in adversarial environments
* Collaborate closely with engineers, researchers, and product managers to operationalise models and integrate them into Kasada’s platform
* Design experiments to rigorously evaluate detection effectiveness and resilience against attacker adaptation
* Stay on the cutting edge of adversarial ML and cybersecurity, translating research into practical defence capabilities
* Communicate insights and outcomes clearly, ensuring technical and business stakeholders can act on findings


**What You’ll Bring**
* 4–6\+ years in data science with exposure to a variety of problem domains
* Production experience with unlabelled data, unsupervised learning or anomaly detection
* You are strong in sampling, inference, uncertainty quantification and are comfortable with high volume time series data
* Fluency with Python, ML libraries and SQL
* Strong experience with transforming data in AWS environments and productionizing notebooks/pipelines
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills — able to influence, teach, and align diverse stakeholders
* Background in cybersecurity, fraud detection, or adversarial ML (preferred)

 A stake in Kasada’s global success with equity/stock options A chance to solve massive, complex, real world problems in cybersecurity faced by our customers that cost millions and impact hundreds of millions of people’s livesFlexible working hours and arrangements \- Create a schedule that suits youSupport for growing families \- Generous parental leave allowances and return to work coachingResources for well\-being to support your growth including our EAP \- confidential counseling for you and your loved onesAn action packed calendar of fun in\-person and virtual events

 Hit the apply button and one of our team will set up an exploratory, confidential discussion. description:

description:

 Atlas Arteria partners to deliver world\-class road experiences. Today the Atlas Arteria Group consists of toll road businesses in France, Germany and the United States. We create long\-term value for our stakeholders through considered and disciplined management and sustainable business practices.
 



  





 Our strategy is to optimise performance, to enhance our competitive position, and to deliver efficient portfolio capital management, all with the aim of creating investor value. These strategic priorities are underpinned by an effective leadership team.
 



  





 Atlas Arteria is listed on the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) and has a market capitalisation of approximately A$7 billion.
 



  





  





**About the role** 




 The Data Scientist works as part of the Forecasting and Analytics team to help Atlas Arteria derive value from its data and enable the business to make data informed decisions. Reporting to the Director Forecasting and Analytics, the role works across a diverse portfolio of businesses to understand their needs, perform relevant data analysis and build and evaluate models to solve problems.
 



  





 The Data Scientist is expected to use their insight and expertise to build and maintain quantitative models that provide data driven strategic insight into how traffic and revenue behaves across the portfolio. The Data Scientist will work across the end\-to\-end process, from data management to ensuring stakeholders have accurate and timely analysis to make effective decisions. In addition, the role works closely with other team members, as well as working with data providers and statistical tools to look at ways to continually evolve and improve the capability and tools used by Atlas Arteria to provide this insight.

 We’re looking for someone who holds a bachelor’s degree or postgraduate qualification in economics, science, engineering or a related field, and has 3 to 5 years’ experience with demand forecasting, financial and/or economic models in the infrastructure sector.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
At Go1, we’re on a mission to help organizations deliver learning and development in more relevant, timely, and effective ways.
 
 From a small startup to now a global brand \- we’ve grown by solving hard problems, embracing ambiguity, and never standing still.
   

  

 If you thrive on change, get energy from big, complex challenges, and are excited to grow fast alongside smart, ambitious people, then Go1 might be exactly what you’re looking for. We offer autonomy with accountability, space to experiment, and the opportunity to shape solutions that impact millions of learners worldwide. We don’t have all the answers — and that’s the point. We figure it out together. Every line of code, every conversation, every bold idea helps move us closer to our mission: to enable individuals, organizations, and society to progress. There’s still so much to build — and even more to discover.
 **Go there with us...**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist to lead the design and development of advanced statistical and machine learning systems, leveraging large language models and experimentation to elevate product experiences and drive product and commercial decision science across our ecosystem.
   

  

 This is a generalist role at a pivotal stage in our data science evolution. You will work across high impact domains including retention, personalisation, attribution, forecasting, classification and experimentation. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying the opportunities that matter the most, eliciting requirements, and rapidly iterating from concept to production. You build solutions that start lean and exploratory, then evolve into robust, trustworthy, scalable data pipelines once value is proven.
   

  

 We operate in a fast paced environment that embraces lots of change. You will join a strong Data Intelligence team of Data Engineers, Data Analysts and a Data Scientist, while partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Commerical and other functions to solve meaningful business problems. You combine deep expertise in machine learning and statistical modelling with sound judgement, knowing when to prototype quickly and when to invest for the long term. You are thoughtful about technical trade\-offs and motivated by solving problems that have not yet been tackled at scale.
   

  

 With a business wide perspective you focus on the highest priorities, assess feasibility pragmatically, and guide stakeholders toward solutions that deliver measurable impact. You will also mentor Data Scientists, and also Data Analysts in the practical application of statistical techniques, strengthening data capability across Go1\.
   

  

 Data Science Product Lifecycle
   

  

* Assess the feasibility of initiatives and experiment with new methodologies to validate concepts and improve algorithms
* Influence business goals, supporting the Data Intelligence Leader in the shaping of our DS Roadmap, services and priorities
* You will analyse large and vast amounts of data and design and build (Python, SQL) reliable, fit for purpose data solutions
* Structure experiments, analysing the outputs and using them to improve performance, as well as recommending ways to improve our experiment infrastructure and approach, to make them faster and more robust
* Partner with Engineering to evaluate and optimise LLM and agentic capabilities through robust measurement frameworks and experimentation


 Data Analysis and Insights
   

  

* Perform critical analyses to inform our strategy, product direction and commercial priorities. Retrieving, synthesising and presenting insights in a format that is immediately useful to answering specific questions, or improving performance
* Develop and evaluate models that improve personalisation and recommendations systems, enhancing user engagement
* Develop and apply lifecycle, retention, and propensity analyses to identify growth opportunities and reduce churn risk
* Design and refine attribution frameworks to better understand acquisition effectiveness and revenue drivers
* Conduct exploratory analysis to uncover trends, patterns, risks and opportunities across engagement, monetisation, and performance


 Communication, Collaboration and Leadership
   

  

* Collaborate cross functionally with Product, Engineering, Content, Customer, Marketing and Sales, Finance
* Mentoring of other Data Scientists as they join our team


**Skills And Experience Required**
* Proficient with data querying languages (SQL), scripting languages (Python)
* 5\+ years of data science experience
* 2\+ years of a/b testing and data visualisation experience
* Experience of successful deployment of AI solutions into Production environments with appropriate governance controls
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts to non\-technical stakeholders
* Required experience with statistical models (regression) and ML models (retrieval, ranking, reinforcement)
* Required experience designing evaluation approaches for AI solutions, ML and LLMs (Agents desirable)
* Desired understanding of personalisation algorithms
* Desired experience in large scale distribution systems (Spark, Elasticsearch) and managing DS pipelines
* Desired Master or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics or related field
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment


**Benefits**
 At Go1, our employee benefits extend far beyond a pay cheque, ensuring our team feels supported, valued, and empowered to bring their best selves to work each day, driving our mission to unlock positive potential through a love of learning.
   

  

* In addition to your base salary: Annual bonus or commission plan.
* Employee Stock Option Plan: Opportunity to share directly in our success through stock options.
* Public Holiday Swap: Swap a public holiday for another preferred day.
* Flexible Working: We are a fully remote organisation with team events and travel throughout the year.
* Wellbeing \& Learning Days: An additional five days of paid leave per year.
* Learning Budget: $500 USD per financial year, plus access to additional Career Growth Budget.
* WFH/Transport Budget: Monthly allowance for internet/phone expenses or public transport.
* Home Office Setup Budget: One\-off allowance for desk, chair and/or monitor.
* Parental Leave: Minimum of 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers \+ 6 weeks paid parental leave for secondary carers.
* Wellbeing Support: Access to counselling and wellbeing app via Nilo Health.

 At MYOB, we believe what’s good for one business is good for all business—and for all of us. Whether you support them, work for them, or dream of building your own, when businesses run smoothly, everybody feels it. Owners, employees, customers, suppliers—even families. That’s why we’re here to give every person in business the tools they need to focus on what really matters and do Big Things—whatever big looks like for them.
   

  

 And for you? Joining MYOB means being part of that impact. It means using your skills to help businesses thrive, shaping the future of work, and growing alongside the people and communities we support. Because while we’re the business of software, we’re really in the business of people. And that makes MYOB Everyone’s Business.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our Data and AI team and help build features that actually make a difference for MYOB's customers.
   

  

 As a Data Scientist, you’ll take ideas from hypothesis all the way to production — prototype → MVP → scale — with clear metrics, robust offline testing, and live A/B experiments to prove impact.
   

  

 You’ll work with product managers, engineers, and designers to frame the right problems, choose the right methods (think transformers, recommenders, time series), and deliver AI that’s scalable and maintainable.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who leads with an experiment\-first mindset, champions responsible AI, and helps lift the whole team through mentoring and knowledge sharing.
   

  

**The Skills You'll Need**
* Consistent record of shipping customer\-facing ML/AI and LLM features end\-to\-end.
* Hands\-on with NLP, RAG, time series, recommenders, anomaly detection and deep learning/transformers.
* Strong Python skills, with production experience in ML frameworks and LLM tooling (HF Transformers, LangChain/LangGraph).
* Cloud\-ready, with experience across AWS services including Bedrock, S3, SageMaker, ECS and Lambda.
* Experimentation\-first approach offline metrics, A/B tests, calibration/drift, human\-in\-the\-loop, and telemetry tied to real outcomes.
* Solid data engineering foundation SQL, NoSQL/vector stores, streaming, data quality/governance, and collaborating on data contracts/observability.
* Strong grounding in security, privacy and compliance, with a passion for


 Responsible AI principles.
   

  

**Our Culture \& Benefits**
 At MYOB our values are at the heart of everything we do. If you want to work and collaborate where opinions are valued, and your ideas can make a difference, come to a place where Your Work Matters.
   

  

 🎥 See what it's like to work at MYOB and what we're all about.
   

  

 🟣Enjoy a flexible, hybrid workplace that brings balance to how you work, all of our centrally located offices come together for a number of in\-person celebrations and social events
   

  

 🟣 Set up your home office with a little financial help from us, and take advantage of great corporate discounts and vouchers from top retailers
   

  

 🟣 Benefit from our partnership with Sonder, which supports the wellbeing of our team members
   

  

 🟣 Unlock your potential via in\-house training and programs, LinkedIn Learning, conferences and study assistance

You will do this in accordance with our legislative, policy and ethical frameworks.
 



  





 In your role, you will be expected to liaise with both customers and engineers and will need to be able to explain the methods and results of your work to people with varying levels of data science experience. Continuous learning and a thirst for knowledge are expected as you maintain your knowledge of both our abilities and the state of the art possibilities, blending the best of what the data science community has on offer. You will need to work in a multi\-disciplinary environment to deliver capabilities that allow ASD’s intelligence and cyber analysts to have the right information, provided in the right way at the right time.
 



  





 Further information can be found at: I’m changing my career \| Australian Signals Directorate (asd.gov.au).
 



  





**Key Duties:** 




**ASD 4 Data Scientist** 




 An ASD 4 Data Scientists, you will work to the broad direction of the executive leadership to perform and achieve complex data generation and analysis work within an integrated workforce. You will require knowledge of compliance with the legislative frameworks, government decision\-making and an understanding of Australian Signals Directorate’s mission.
 



  





 You will be deliberate with the learning of technical and analytical skills and proactive with communicating with their team and leadership. You will exercise sound decision\-making to provide technical advice and in line with direction, will engage in complex problem solving to deliver data science solutions that affect strategic, political or operational outcomes for the Australian Signals Directorate.
 



  





 You will positively contribute to building team capability and will be accountable to contribute towards ongoing self\-improvement and professional development for their career.
 



  





**ASD 5 Data Scientist** 




 An ASD 5 Data Scientist will work under limited direction to perform and achieve complex data generation and analysis work within an integrated workforce. You are accountable to have and maintain a well\-developed understanding of compliance to relevant legislative frameworks, government decision\-making and the Australian Signals Directorate’s mission and policy requirements.
 



  





 You will be accountable for organising your workflow and making independent decisions relating to their area of responsibility. You will interpret and provide advice within the data function area based on legislation, policy and procedures. You will undertake research and analysis, conduct investigations and perform data generation and analysis work to achieve results.
 



  





 You may coordinate and contribute to the work of a team and provide advice and assistance on methods of task completion to team members. You may be a team coach and are expected to be capable of reviewing and developing the quality of work undertaken by others and identifying opportunities for on\-the\-job training within a work unit.
 



  





 As a Data Scientist, you will be required to engage and communicate with stakeholders to respond and provide advice on issues to mission outcomes. You will be accountable to contribute towards ongoing self\-improvement and professional development.
 



  





**ASD 6 Data Scientist** 




 An ASD 6 Data Scientist is accountable, under the broad direction of the executive leadership, to perform and achieve complex to very complex data generation and analysis work within an integrated workforce. You will require knowledge of compliance with legislative frameworks, government decision\-making and strong understanding of Australian Signals Directorate’s mission.
 



  





 You will exercise a degree of independence and perform a subject matter expert role. You will exercise sound decision making and judgement to provide strong technical advice. Engage in complex to very complex problem solving and issue management and may coordinate and contribute to detailed or sensitive projects that impact on strategic, political or operational outcomes for the Australian Signals Directorate.
 



  





 You may be a Line Manager and mentor, and will be accountable for the outcomes of the planning for work and performance goals. You are expected to be capable of building team capability through coaching, feedback and developing the quality of work undertaken by others within a work unit.
 



  





 As a Data Scientist, you will be involved in key stakeholder relationships and will be required to identify relevant stakeholders’ expectations and concerns to develop and communicate methodologies and practices to achieve outcomes. You will be accountable to contribute towards ongoing self\-improvement and professional development of their work area.

 Data scientist roles within Mission Data Division (MDD) develops capabilities and data solutions to enable ASD mission areas, to support ASD and ADF mission requirements.

 As part of your job, ASD will support you and provide opportunities to stay up\-to\-date with the latest trends and technologies to develop new ways to collect information and solve intelligence problems. The work we do is unique, critical and incredibly rewarding.

description:
**Who we are**
